Saki Endo (Japanese: 遠藤沙季 Endō Saki) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Endo was born on March 7, 1986 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during , where she voiced Team Skull Admin Plumeria. Endo is currently affiliated with New Walkers.
